cards.label: Notting Hill
cards.text: A man on Portobello Road is hanging bunting from a window that isn't his. Nobody stops him. The street has the look of somewhere that is always about to throw a party and never quite admits it's already started.
He hands you a paper flag on the way past, as though you'd been on the guest list all along. The emotion-type in your bag warms by a degree.
